title: Counting Bits: Lamps Lit, One Shift at a Time
summary: Each number's lit lamps are the count for half of it, plus its last lamp: one shift and one lookup.

analogy.scenario: A scoreboard shows numbers 0 to 6 with three lamps worth 4, 2, and 1. For each number, how many lamps are lit?

mapping.real: Sliding the lamps one place right

takeaway.summary: ones[i] = ones[i >> 1] + (i & 1): shifting right drops the last bit, leaving a smaller number already counted.
whenToUse: Counting bits for a whole range

scenes.narration: A scoreboard shows numbers 0 to 6 with three lamps worth 4, 2, and 1. For each number, how many lamps are lit?
scenes.caption: Numbers 0–6 on three lamps (4, 2, 1): how many are lit?

scenes.narration: You could check every lamp of every number, looping over all the bits each time. But each number's lamps are mostly a smaller number's lamps, already counted.
scenes.caption: Checking every lamp of every number repeats the work

scenes.narration: Zero lights no lamps: the count starts at 0.
scenes.caption: 0 lights no lamps

scenes.narration: For 1, slide the lamps one place right: that drops the last lamp and leaves 0, already counted as 0. The dropped lamp was lit, so add 1.
scenes.caption: 1: shift right gives 0, plus the last lamp: 1

scenes.narration: 2 shifted right is 1, which lights one lamp. Its last lamp is off, so 2 lights one lamp too.
scenes.caption: 2 = 010: shifted it's 1 (one lamp), last lamp off: 1

scenes.narration: 3 shifted right is also 1, with one lamp, and its last lamp is lit: 2.
scenes.caption: 3 = 011: shifted it's 1, plus a lit last lamp: 2

scenes.narration: Shifting right drops the last lamp and leaves half the number, always smaller, so its count is already in the table. 5 becomes 2, one lamp, plus the last lamp: 2.
scenes.caption: 5 = 101: shifted it's 2 (one lamp), plus 1: 2

scenes.narration: 6 shifted right is 3, with two lamps, and its last lamp is off: 2. The whole board is counted.
scenes.caption: 6 = 110: shifted it's 3 (two lamps), last off: 2

scenes.narration: Lamps are bits. Each count is the count for i shifted right, plus the last bit: one lookup per number, O(n) time.
scenes.caption: ones[i] = ones[i >> 1] + (i & 1)
